title: Gram-Positive Bacteria — StatPearls (Sizar, Leslie, Unakal)

claims.text: Streptococcus pneumoniae is a gram-positive, encapsulated, lancet-shaped diplococcus, and is among the organisms that cause meningitis.
claims.byte_quote: Streptococcus pneumoniae is a gram-positive, encapsulated, lancet-shaped diplococci, most commonly causing otitis media, pneumonia, sinusitis, and meningitis.

cites: SCOPE project (Surveillance and Control of Pathogens of Epidemiologic Importance)
